alert_news.title: India's First Orbital Computing Satellite MOI-1A
bullets: MOI-1A, India's first orbital computing satellite, developed by Hyderabad startup TakeMe2Space, to launch on SpaceX Transporter‑18.
Sub‑50 kg satellite equipped with Nvidia Orin NX processors, 150 W power, performs edge AI inference in orbit, reducing data downlink.

alert_news.title: India's first orbital data center to be launched in 2028
bullets: Hyderabad‑based TakeMe2Space will launch India's first orbital data center in 2028.
Two 100‑kg satellites, each carrying 10 Nvidia Thor GPUs, 100 TB storage, and 1.5 kW power, will be launched on SpaceX Falcon 9 as part of the Waymaker 2 rideshare mission.
The satellites will be networked via optical inter‑satellite links, making it the first Indian mission to link computing across multiple spacecraft.

alert_news.title: India’s first orbital data centre test with satellites on SpaceX Falcon 9

alert_news.title: India's First Port-Based e-Methanol Production Facility at Kandla
bullets: India’s first port‑based e‑methanol production facility will be built at Kandla (Deendayal Port) in Gujarat.
The project, valued at ₹2,300 crore, is expected to create about 3,500 jobs and produce e‑methanol using green hydrogen and captured CO₂.
The facility will supply low‑carbon marine fuel, supporting green shipping and India’s net‑zero target by 2070.

alert_news.title: “ India's First LNG Powered Train Is Here”: Amit Shah Flags Off New Railway Initiative
bullets: India’s first LNG‑powered train, flagged off from Sabarmati, Ahmedabad, by Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel.
Dual‑fuel system uses 1,400‑hp Driving Power Cars with 2,200‑litre LNG tanks, capable of replacing up to 40% of diesel consumption.

alert_news.title: India's First LNG-Powered Train Flagged Off by Amit Shah - Sanskriti IAS
bullets: India’s first LNG‑powered train, launched from Sabarmati Railway Station, Ahmedabad, on 27 September 2026.
Dual‑fuel technology allows 1,400‑hp Driving Power Cars to switch between LNG and diesel, reducing diesel usage by up to 40%.

alert_news.title: India’s First Networked Orbital Data Centre Mission by TakeMe2Space
bullets: First Indian mission to deploy a networked orbital data centre, planned for 2028, launched by Hyderabad‑based TakeMe2Space on SpaceX Falcon 9
Two 100‑kg MOI satellites, each carrying 10 Nvidia Thor GPUs, 100 TB storage, 1.5 kW power, a 1‑m multispectral imager and optical inter‑satellite laser links

alert_news.title: India LNG Train Flagged Off as Railways Cut Diesel Use
bullets: India’s first LNG‑powered train was flagged off from Sabarmati railway station, Gujarat, by Indian Railways.
The launch is part of a ₹1,472 crore rail development programme that includes Kavach train‑protection system and line‑doubling.
The LNG train aims to cut diesel consumption and enhance environmental sustainability.

alert_news.title: Home Minister flags off India's first LNG train
bullets: India’s first liquefied natural gas (LNG)‑powered train launched from Sabarmati Station, Gujarat, by Union Home Minister Amit Shah
The train employs a diesel‑plus‑LNG dual‑fuel system for its Driving Power Cars (DPCs) and is part of a Rs 1,542 crore rail safety and infrastructure programme

alert_news.title: India's First LNG-Powered Train Launched from Sabarmati Station
bullets: India’s first LNG‑powered train, launched from Sabarmati Railway Station, Ahmedabad, by Indian Railways
Two 1,400‑hp driving power cars converted to diesel‑LNG dual‑fuel; LNG replaces ~40% of diesel, tank capacity ~2,200 L for ~444 km per full tank
Project part of Sabarmati Division’s ₹1,472 crore rail upgrade, including new signalling and maintenance facilities

alert_news.title: India's First LNG-Diesel Dual-Fuel DEMU Train Flags Off Today
bullets: India’s first LNG‑diesel dual‑fuel DEMU train, flagged off from Sabarmati railway station, Gujarat, by Western Railway Ahmedabad Division.
Dual‑fuel system uses a 2,200‑litre LNG tank per power car, enabling ~444 km range on LNG and up to 40% diesel consumption reduction.
Eight‑coach DEMU operates between Sabarmati and Mahesana, demonstrating cleaner alternative fuel for Indian Railways.

alert_news.title: APSEZ's Dhamra Port becomes India's first large-scale private multi-cargo port to run fully on renewable electricity
bullets: Dhamra Port, Odisha, operated by APSEZ, became India’s first large‑scale private multi‑cargo port powered entirely by renewable electricity.
Renewable supply exceeds 108 GWh annually, meeting over 90 lakh units of monthly demand through captive hybrid plant, third‑party access, and green‑power procurement.
Shift completed in August 2026, aligning with APSEZ’s Net‑Zero strategy and reducing emissions from port operations.

alert_news.title: IIT Delhi builds India's first working indigenous micro-GPU for low-cost displays, fishing boats & e-book readers
bullets: IIT Delhi researchers developed India’s first working indigenous micro‑GPU, demonstrated on a Spartan 7 FPGA board.
Micro‑GPU designed for low‑cost embedded graphics in devices such as displays, fishing boats, and e‑book readers.
Project led by M.Tech students under Prof. Jayadeva and Prof. Kaushik Saha, showcasing programmable graphics hardware for affordable computing platforms.

alert_news.title: Sawan Barwal Ends 44‑Year Wait, Wins India's First Asian Games Marathon Medal Since 1982
bullets: India's first Asian Games marathon medal in 44 years, silver won by Sawan Barwal at the 2026 Asian Games
Time 2:11:37, setting a new national record

alert_news.title: First Ascent Mountaineering Expedition in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first-ever ascent of 20 unclimbed peaks above 6,000 m in Ladakh, achieved by a 20‑member team from the National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS) under the Ministry of Defence
The expedition covered 20 peaks in 23 days, led by Colonel Ranveer Singh Jamwal, marking a national first in high‑altitude mountaineering
